correctness.rationale: For a>=2 and b/a->0, b->infty, finite eta, the killed-chain matrix Q has characteristic polynomial z²-uz-vw. Independent symbolic algebra gives 1-u-vw=(ak+aℓ+bk-kℓ)/(a(a+b-1)) and derivatives ∂k λ+=-(1+b/a)/(a+2b-1), ∂ℓ λ+=-1/(a+2b-1). For fixed factorial moment orders, spectral gap stays bounded, t=O(a log a), and accumulated O(a^-2) error vanishes; the subdominant eigenvalue O(b/a) dies. Starting-class exclusions in the exact falling-factorial identity give mixed Poisson moments, moment determinacy and discrete tightness give total variation, and zero unvisited vertices gives CDF. Lambert identity w exp w=log a gives eta=w²/log a->0. No inference from finite checks to infinite limit.
